top_findings.title: GET /books/{id} unreachable at runtime — mux never routes /books/{id}
top_findings.evidence: main.go:268 registers http.HandleFunc("/books", ...); Go's ServeMux treats a no-trailing-slash pattern as an exact path, so it matches only "/books". Empirically verified: a live server returns Go's default "404 page not found" for curl /books/1. The else-branch at main.go:277-288 is dead at runtime. TestGetBookById (main_test.go:188) passes only by calling getBookHandler directly.
top_findings.suggestion: Register "/books/" (trailing slash) or use Go 1.22 patterns e.g. "GET /books/{id}".

top_findings.title: PUT /books/{id} unreachable at runtime — same mux routing defect
top_findings.evidence: updateBookHandler (main.go:168) is dispatched only from the else-branch (main.go:281); "/books/1" never matches the exact "/books" pattern (main.go:268). Empirically verified: curl -X PUT /books/1 returns "404 page not found". TestUpdateBook (main_test.go:221) passes only by calling updateBookHandler directly.
top_findings.suggestion: Same fix as R4 — register "/books/" or a Go 1.22 "PUT /books/{id}" pattern.

top_findings.title: DELETE /books/{id} unreachable at runtime — same mux routing defect
top_findings.evidence: deleteBookHandler (main.go:222) is dispatched only from the else-branch (main.go:283); "/books/1" does not match "/books" (main.go:268). Empirically verified: curl -X DELETE /books/1 returns "404 page not found". TestDeleteBook (main_test.go:246) passes only by calling deleteBookHandler directly.
top_findings.suggestion: Same fix as R4 — register "/books/" or a Go 1.22 "DELETE /books/{id}" pattern.
